summary: When a PR has no test or review results, its description now links the local review that still covers the commit. Shaka refuses description text that cites a review finding only by a number such as `N3`.

intent.why: #1301 said nothing was verified although a review covered it, and cited a finding only as `N3`.
intent.user_impact: Maintainers see which review covers an unverified PR.
intent.root_cause: Results attach only to the exact tested files, and the message ignored reviews `merge` accepts.
intent.safe_because: Uses `merge`'s rule, records no results, and adds nothing when no review applies.
intent.scope: Review link when results are missing, finding-number refusal, settings guide.

checks: Validation passed with `validate` on the reviewed head.
A CLI test in `test/` renders a description with no results and asserts the covering review link.
verification.not_verified: A live no-results description; a CLI test covers that path.

checkpoint.audience: Maintainers deciding whether to merge a PR whose description has no results.
checkpoint.repair_history: Not recorded in the frozen case.
